notes.title: First update after launch
notes.notes:
The first week after SANYA's release has passed! Thanks to everyone who played, and gave feedback. Your kind words tell us that the 4 years spent developing the game were worth it.

Today we're sharing our first update! Here's what's new:

[olist]
[*] SANYA is now available on MacOS!
[*] Fixed a bug that made it hard to dial numbers on the phone.
[*] Fixed a bug where the mini-game with the phone would freeze after the first phrase and not allow further progress.
[*] Saves are now showing correctly.
[/olist]

We're still working on a bug where sometimes [spoiler] you can't pull the Punpkin out of the tree roots [/spoiler]. If you come across this issue, please email us at helpnodegames@gmail.com.

If you find any other bugs, please let us know wherever you can: here in the comments, game discussions, on Twitter, or via email.

Sending everyone hugs, wishing you a fantastic week, and may Pumpkin always be by your side!

A huge thanks to [url=tabularasaloc.com ]Tabula Rasa[/url] for delivering an excellent translation!
